headline: Bitcoin Rebounds Above $60,000 Following Fall to Two-Year Low
summary: Bitcoin traded near $60,200 after plummeting to $55,251, marking its lowest price level in two years. Crypto markets have experienced volatile swings amid broader risk asset pressures.
why: Bitcoin is the largest cryptocurrency by market capitalization and serves as a key sentiment indicator for digital asset markets.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Bitcoin experienced intraday recovery after touching multi-year support levels.

why_moved: Technical buying triggered a rebound after prices breached two-year lows.
